title: Shinonome Ena — I Want To Capture That Expression〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: I Want To Capture That Expression（4★）
meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...? When did I fall asleep...?
And it's almost noon...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, where'd the sketch for my assignment go? Don't tell me that was all a dream...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It must've fallen off my bed while I was asleep. And it didn't get crumpled up. Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll take this opportunity to fix the parts that look funny...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh... But I'm starting to get hungry.
I think I'll grab something to eat and drink first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Crap...
If I go down now, I'd have to see his face...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I'll just have to wait to go downstairs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It made me wonder why am I doing the opposite of what my mom is telling me to do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because that's what you wanted to do, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You want to make music and go to SEKAI. It doesn't matter what she says. You're not willing to give those things up. You want to be a part of N25. Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just look at me. I draw because I want to draw, and I believe I'll be rewarded in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I would think that there's a part of you that knows what would truly make you happy. And it's not what your mom decides...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I get that what your parents say matters... But not being able to do what you want because of them is just...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does it upset the genius artist when his talentless daughter draws?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Anyone can draw.
There's no rule that says you need to have talent to do it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just thinking about that makes my blood boil...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if I was told to quit drawing that time...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I probably would've fought back with everything I had...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He didn't tell me to quit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, those were just empty words.
He was pitying his talentless daughter is all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should get back to working on my sketch instead of dwelling on the past.
